lr_rationale: Batch-one gradients are noisy; Stage A only established finite losses at 0.005 for 128 updates. Use fivefold lower base LR with two-epoch warm-up as a conservative, unoptimized safety choice. Three epochs cannot validate later decay milestones.

decision.rule: Prefer weighted only with finite losses, no overall AP50 or AP50:95 regression above 0.01, and improved aggregate minority exposure or supported minority macro AP. Require supported minority macro AP not to regress when judging exposure-only benefit. Otherwise prefer unweighted; single-seed three-epoch evidence is provisional.

scope: Configuration selection only; 1000 train / 250 calibration. Reserved 1500 never opened. Full 20 epochs requires separate authorization.
